description: Hello and welcome to our team Lumpy Space Princess (LSP) ! We are a group of 5 passionate engineering students looking forward to solve space-related issues with our diverse ideas and strategies. Each of our group members have our own unique strengths such as high critical thinking, good communication skills and knowledge regarding space that allow us to work as a team and solve this challenge!
summary: Our project is about astronauts who are stranded on the moon and their mission is to collect enough parts of the rocket's subsystems to be able to fix their rocket. We developed a simple and enjoyable game for everyone to play. It talks about the issues of astronauts who are stranded on the moon, and it teaches the players regarding the parts of a rocket. Besides that, as most of us here are future aerospace engineers, we believe it is important to be aware of the parts present in a space rocket and also be aware of issues that astronauts may face in space.
details: Our project aims to give every player on Roblox exposure and knowledge about space while enjoying the game at the same time. The tools that were used in the making of this project is Roblox studio and Claude AI. Our project is creative as it focuses on the matter of rocket parts and how we could survive as an astronaut on the moon. We created our game in a way that tries to capture people's attention and keep them immersed, such as the oxygen mechanism where if the players are not careful with their oxygen level in space, they could be in fatal condition. We hope players will enjoy playing this simple game we tried our best to create!
dataRefs: Artemis II- Journey to the Moon
